result.summary: Found 2 layout issues: category chips overflow the screen edge, and a restaurant name is clipped in the Fastest near you row.

issues.description: The last visible category chip ('Healthy') is cut off at the right edge of the screen, so the filter label is incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Give the category chip row enough horizontal padding or allow it to scroll so every chip, including the last one, is fully visible.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated at the right edge of the Fastest near you carousel, so the full name cannot be read.
issues.suggestion: Ensure restaurant titles wrap or ellipsize cleanly within the card, or give the last card enough space so the name is not clipped by the viewport.
